Maria Chen: Heads up — inbound H100 pallet from NexaSupply hit customs discrepancy. PO shows SKUs H100-64G and H100-80G, but manifest lists 2 x H100-legacy-1234. Can vendor confirm? :exclamation:
Michael (NexaSupply): Sorry, looks like 2 units were mis-stickered at our crossdock. We still shipped the correct boards but with legacy labels. We'll pull the two affected units and re-label. Propose air reconsolidate to AMS next flight.
Jin Park: If we do air reconsolidate, what's the ETA to get them back into production racks? Also will customs re-inspect and add hold time?
Michael (NexaSupply): ETA after reissue AWB ~24-36h + customs clearance. We can provide e-AWB and updated commercial invoice with corrected HS code 8473.30. Processing time depends on AMS customs queue, estimate 12-18h for clearance.
Leo Santos: We have 6 hot spares in AMS but 4 are committed to Q config tomorrow morning. If reconsolidate takes 36h we're looking at ~48h risk window. Ops can extend slot reservations but need confirmation by EOD.
Ana Gómez: Also two units arrived with damaged heatsink foam — need RMA for DOA/partial damage. Michael, can you issue RMA numbers and return labels for those? We prefer vendor to handle inbound return to your EU depot.
Michael (NexaSupply): Will issue RMA now. AWB and RMA plan below:
```
AWB: NL1234567890 (mislabelled pallet)
AWB: NL0987654321 (re-ship corrected labels, next-flight)
RMA-IDs: RMA-EU-7782, RMA-EU-7783 (damaged heatsinks)
Customs doc ref: INV-5678, HS: 847330
```
Maria Chen: Ops: please hold the two flagged units from intake and don't stage to cluster until we confirm re-label. Jin, can you gate the intake? @Jin Park
Jin Park: On it. I'll set intake hold tag and block auto-staging. Created hold in WMS: HOLD-3209. Leaving 2 units in quarantine.
OpsBot: WMS hold HOLD-3209 created by Jin Park at 2026-03-18T10:12:00Z.
Michael (NexaSupply): We'll send e-AWB and re-label manifest to customs and share tracking. Also offering credit for damaged foam; will process RMA and arrange return pickup next-business-day.
Leo Santos: Quick ask — if vendor reissues via next-flight (same-day), do we need to change routing? Cost implications? Procurement, FYI: air reconsolidate vs road rework costs approx +€1.8k.
Ana Gómez: Acknowledge cost. Procurement will approve urgent routing if it keeps cluster healthy. Maria, please confirm we want air reconsolidate and vendor RMA pickup.
Maria Chen: Confirmed: vendor to re-ship corrected-labeled units via next-flight AWB NL0987654321, provide RMA labels for RMA-EU-7782/7783. Ops to keep hold, stagger swap with spares. Procurement to accept air surcharge up to €2k. Update me when AWB is uploaded. :thumbsup:
Michael (NexaSupply): Copy — uploading documents now, will DM AWB PDF once available. Sorry for the mixup, we'll expedite the RMA pickup and credit.
Jin Park: Noted. I'll schedule staggered replacement and notify RackOps to avoid disruption.
Maria Chen: Thanks team. Keeping thread open until AWB + RMA labels received.
